items.description: Tangier Med is one of Africa's largest ports and a vital maritime gateway between Europe and Africa.
The Renault Tangier plant is a major automotive manufacturing facility, contributing significantly to Morocco's industrial sector.
Al-Qarawiyyin University in Fès is one of the oldest universities in the world, a center of Islamic learning and culture.
Tinmal Mosque, nestled in the Atlas Mountains, is a significant historical site and an architectural marvel of the Almohad dynasty.
Sijilmasa was a medieval city and a major trade hub on the trans-Saharan routes, now an extensive archaeological site.
Dar al-Makhzen in Rabat is the official residence of the King of Morocco, showcasing impressive Islamic architecture.
Casablanca Cathedral, also known as Sacred Heart Church, is a stunning example of Art Deco architecture with neo-Gothic influences.
Dar el Bacha in Marrakech is a magnificent palace, once a pasha's residence and now a museum of Moroccan culture.
Saint Peter's Cathedral in Rabat is a Roman Catholic cathedral known for its distinctive twin towers and European architectural style.
The Palmeraie of Marrakech is a vast palm grove offering a tranquil escape for camel rides and relaxation.
Dakhla Bay is a crucial bird habitat, especially for flamingos and other migratory species, in the Western Sahara.
Berkane is a fertile region known for its citrus fruit production, especially oranges and clementines.
The Oued Noun region is characterized by traditional agriculture, with date palms and argan trees dominating the landscape.
Meknes Zoo offers a collection of regional and exotic animals, providing an educational experience for families.
The Moroccan Sahara is the natural habitat for dromedary camels, essential for desert transport and nomadic life.
